# Scott Christensen · Growth Design

> Portfolio of Scott Christensen, growth design leader and cofounder of SendSight. Every page has a plain-markdown twin at the same path with a .md extension.

Scott Christensen is a growth design leader based in Salt Lake City with 15 years of experience connecting design craft to strategy and growth. He is cofounder of [SendSight](https://sendsight.ai), which automates lifecycle journey insights for growth teams, and alongside that takes on one fractional growth design engagement at a time.

Previously: Design Lead, Growth at [Mercury](https://mercury.com) (2023–2025); Director of Product Design at [H1](https://h1.co) (2020–2022); Founding Designer at [Mystery](https://www.trymystery.com) (2019–2020); Lead Designer / Design Manager at Egencia, an Expedia company (2018–2019); Product Designer / Sr. Designer at PwC Experience Center (2015–2018); Management Consultant at PwC's Strategy& (2013–2015). He helped start [GrowthDesigners.co](https://growthdesigners.co), a community for growth designers, by creating its Slack community in 2018, and has spent about eight years helping build it to 3,000+ members. He also co-leads [Growth Design School](https://www.growthdesigners.co/school), the community's growth design course.

Education: Brigham Young University (BYU), business strategy, graduated 2013. He moved from management consulting into design and is self-taught as a designer.

Profiles: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/scottcharleschristensen/) · [X @_ScottC_](https://x.com/_ScottC_) · [GitHub](https://github.com/scottchristensen) · [Medium @ScottC](https://medium.com/@ScottC)

Not to be confused with other people named Scott Christensen, including a painter of the same name. This Scott Christensen is the product and growth designer described on scottchristensen.design.

## Pages

- [Scott Christensen: Growth Design Leader](https://scottchristensen.design/index.md): Portfolio home for Scott Christensen, growth design leader and SendSight cofounder: current focus, selected case studies, background, and experience.
- [Growth Design Advisory Services](https://scottchristensen.design/advisory.md): Scott's fractional growth design services: two retainer models and four fixed-price audits, with published pricing and time commitments.
- [Content: talks, podcasts, writing, and community](https://scottchristensen.design/content.md): Scott's interviews and talks on growth design careers and product-led growth, the GrowthDesigners.co community and Growth Design School he built, his Medium writing, and free Figma resources.
- [Mercury Focused Funding: case study](https://scottchristensen.design/work/mercury-focused-funding.md): Adding friction lifted Day 30 deposits 7%. Mercury's deposit rate was plateauing despite a tidal wave of new applications after the Silicon Valley Bank collapse.
- [Mercury Viral Upsell: case study](https://scottchristensen.design/work/mercury-viral-upsell.md): Layered education lifted new accounts 6%. Mercury's viral upsell, the page non-Mercury users land on when a Mercury customer sends or requests money, was a slapped-together boilerplate form.
- [H1 Extension: case study](https://scottchristensen.design/work/h1-browser-extension.md): Validated, launched, iterated. I led the design for H1's exploratory browser extension and Explorer web app products.
- [Mystery Onboarding: case study](https://scottchristensen.design/work/mystery-onboarding.md): Data-driven new user flow. Using a data-driven approach, I redesigned Mystery's native app onboarding and increased adoption by 10%.
